requirements.description: Proposals must focus on next-generation AI agents as autonomous systems powered by large AI language models (e.g., large language models or large multimodal models) that can plan, utilise tools and perform actions autonomously to achieve specified goals based on high-level instructions.
Key aspects in designing effective AI agents include robust planning, reasoning, and search mechanisms that allow agents to approach complex tasks by breaking them down into structured subgoals.
Effective memory and state management are necessary to maintaining coherent long-term interactions, achieved through a balanced integration of short-term and external long-term memory solutions.
Integrating external tools and APIs is essential for overcoming limitations in large AI models, enhancing agent performance in tasks requiring accuracy and reliability.
Potential research area: enhancing AI agent autonomy through advanced self-planning and self-optimization capabilities, enabling agents to improve their decision-making and strategic planning.
Potential research area: innovation in memory-augmented AI agents to facilitate robust long-term reasoning and lifelong learning.
Potential research area: developing advanced multi-agent frameworks specifically tailored for collaborative agents, including research on AI agent frameworks based on mixed AI architectures.
Potential research area: advancing multimodal reasoning capabilities to enable real-world applications.
Proposals must incorporate mechanisms for assessing and demonstrating progress, including qualitative and quantitative KPIs, benchmarking, and progress monitoring.
Proposals must allocate tasks for cohesion activities with ADRA (European Partnership on AI, data, and robotics) and the CSA HORIZON-CL4-2025-03-HUMAN-18: GenAI4EU central Hub.

Portfolio coverage requirement: at least one funded project must focus on healthcare, one on advanced manufacturing, and one on in-vehicle autonomous driving, subject to passing all evaluation thresholds.
Proposals should build on or seek collaboration with relevant projects and develop synergies with other relevant International, European, national, or regional initiatives.
